matches.title: Borussia Dortmund vs Villarreal
matches.description: Watch Borussia Dortmund vs Villarreal highlights and goals from UEFA Champions League on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on September 8, 2026. On September 8, 2026, the UEFA Champions League delivered a high-octane encounter as Borussia Dortmund hosted Villarreal in a match that kept fans on the edge of their seats until the very last second. Both sides displayed tactical discipline and flashes of brilliance in a game where momentum swung like a pendulum. A Tactical Stalemate in the Opening Period The first half was a story of missed opportunities and defensive organization. Villarreal looked dangerous through Tajon Buchanan early on, while Borussia Dortmund struggled to make their set-piece dominance count, with multiple corners from Julian Ryerson failing to find a teammate. The physical nature of the contest was evident as Waldemar Anton and Pau Navarro both saw yellow cards for tactical fouls. Just before the break, Serhou Guirassy had a clear sighting of goal, but his header lacked the necessary accuracy, leaving the match scoreless as the teams headed to the tunnels. Breakthroughs and Counter-Punches The intensity shifted gears significantly in the second half. Ethan Nwaneri nearly broke the deadlock in the 51st minute, but his strike agonisingly rattled the post. The pressure eventually forced a mistake in the 53rd minute when Renato Veiga inadvertently turned the ball into his own net to give Dortmund the lead. The Spanish side refused to fold, however, and found an equalizer in the 66th minute. Santiago Mouriño rose highest to meet a Georges Mikautadze corner, heading home to silence the home crowd and reset the contest. Guirassy's Double and Late Drama As the game entered the closing stages, Borussia Dortmund ’s tactical changes paid dividends. In the 80th minute, Fabio Silva provided a pinpoint assist for Serhou Guirassy , who finished clinically with his left foot. The drama intensified minutes later when a VAR review confirmed a penalty for a shirt-pull by Mouriño . Guirassy stepped up and coolly converted the spot-kick to make it 3-1. There was still time for a final twist, as Guirassy scored an unfortunate own goal in the 90th minute to bridge the gap. Despite the late tension and a post-match scuffle, Dortmund maintained their composure to secure a vital victory.

The atmosphere at the PreZero Arena was electric for this Bundesliga clash on September 5, 2026 , as Hoffenheim and Borussia Dortmund squared off in a match defined by tactical shifts and relentless energy. With 30,150 fans in attendance, the game delivered a narrative filled with unexpected twists that kept everyone guessing until the final whistle. Tactical Battle and the Breakthrough The first half saw Hoffenheim controlling much of the ball, maintaining 60% possession while searching for a gap in the Borussia Dortmund structure. Early chances were exchanged, with Maximilian Beier seeing a header comfortably saved by Oliver Baumann , while at the other end, Adam Hlozek tested Gregor Kobel . The deadlock was finally broken in the 45th minute in spectacular fashion. Leon Avdullahu found space outside the box and unleashed a right-footed strike following a setup by Vladimir Coufal , sending the home side into the tunnel with a hard-earned lead. Second Half Surge and the Dortmund Response The momentum stayed with the hosts early in the second period. In the 54th minute, Tim Lemperle doubled the advantage for Hoffenheim with a deflected shot, assisted by Adam Daghim . Facing a two-goal deficit, Borussia Dortmund refused to fold. The comeback trail began in the 61st minute when Serhou Guirassy capitalized on a defensive lapse by Leon Avdullahu to clinical finish. The momentum shifted instantly, and just five minutes later, substitute Fabio Silva leveled the score with a clinical left-footed finish, with Guirassy turning provider this time. Late Drama and a Cruel Twist As the match entered its final stages, the intensity boiled over, resulting in a flurry of yellow cards for players including Wouter Burger , Maximilian Beier , and Andrej Kramaric . The defining moment arrived in the 86th minute, but not through a piece of brilliance. Albian Hajdari inadvertently directed the ball into his own net, gifting Borussia Dortmund their first lead of the match. Despite five minutes of added time and a series of desperate corners from Vladimir Coufal and Mats Rots , the Dortmund defense held firm. Key clearances from Waldemar Anton and Luca Reggiani ensured the visitors completed a remarkable turnaround to claim all three points.

Reduced to ten men, Borussia Dortmund was forced to defend deep.
